g.text: GALINI / L03 / SEC01 / Ferry departures and shore choice
Named encounter section / adjacent architecture, explicit positions and a bounded review question
Ferry exits divide before Laundry undercroft and Cooper
rise; shore remains a separate ground commitment. A
sighting at Cooper does not identify the whole attack.
Buildings, not a spawn screen, form departures.
Follower can keep the near return or move toward Cooper.
The long shore is not a free late rotation; its usefulness
Affected: M01, M02, M03, S1, S2, R6. Walk routes: R01,
R02, R03. All circles are body centers, not measured
L03 / geometry prediction. Later capture each listed stance from both sides, include the follower, and inspect standing/crouched exposure plus all intermediate stair or ramp
positions. Roofs and slabs remain opaque. Movement openings and observation apertures are different contracts.
